question: does a single stateless HARVEST(fruit) candidate injected into main_candidates/endgame_candidates for a harvest-capable unit whose current chop target is its own ripe-fruited cell at shack-distance <=2 clear the mechanism gate (>=70% reduction of the chop-shadow-shack<=2 harvest_slack sub-class, total harvest_slack not increased, the other five waste detectors not worsened) and the value gates (non-regression overall + activated-subset >= +1.0) on a fresh 2,048-task panel?
root_cause: B3.5 diagnosis (scratchpad b35-harvest-slack-diagnosis-report.md): YamoBot::main_candidates (yamo_orchard_live.rs:3084-3145 pre-fix) and endgame_candidates (:3200-3339 pre-fix) never construct a HARVEST candidate for ripe fruit on any cell; yamo_chop_candidates scores purely by wood yield with zero reference to plant.fruits, so a harvest-capable unit standing on a fruited tree it is chopping destroys the fruit with the tree every time (33.4% of all harvest_slack episodes).
